column1: # TITLE: Small cell neuroendocrine transdifferentiation in EGFR-mutant lung cancer evolving from mesenchymal drug-tolerant state

# SUMMARY: Small-cell neuroendocrine (SCN) transdifferentiation and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) are recognized as two kinds of lineage plasticity and they emerged as a model of targeted therapy evasion in a subset of EGFR-mutated NSCLC. Whether SCN transdifferentiation could phenocopy in isogenic acquired resistant clinically relevant cells and the association between EMT and SCN transdifferentiation remain unknown. 　We established several mesenchymal gefitinib-acquired resistant cells from HCC827 and showed SCN transdifferentiation could evolve from mesenchymal drug-tolerant state. The SCN property and the mesenchymal property in cancer cells are negatively correlated. Dynamic IL-6
